provider_unknown_policy: Deny affected provider-controlled operation until grant established.
local_policy: Do not require ownership proof uploads. Expose technically supported local operations; retain known restrictions and user-managed rights responsibility.
enforcement_points: outgoing model context and tool results
diagnostic export for the selected destination and purpose
model_egress_policy: Deny prohibited or unknown provider-controlled AI ingestion before any model, embedding, ranking, tool result or log; user consent does not override a source restriction.
spotify_default: No Spotify-derived content in AI inference/embeddings/training or generic ripping without an applicable grant; standard API discovery/display requires separate reviewed use-case compliance.
acquisition_policy: Implement the selected link-to-file capability with direct-file, documented vendor and maintained-extractor candidates. Preserve requested catalog identity and actual media source. Technical feasibility, service-access basis, content-use basis and distribution eligibility are independent; unofficial classification alone does not reject technical investigation. No website claim or user consent fabricates a missing source grant.
resolution_semantics: For provider-controlled operations, any denied constraint denies; otherwise any unknown constraint remains unknown and cannot activate. Allowed requires all applicable grants plus implemented capability and device/entitlement eligibility. User-managed local files follow the separate local policy, not invented provider-grant requirements.
source_separation_rule: Catalog metadata and acquired media retain distinct provenance. Spotify-derived metadata does not lose its restrictions after matching/import; independently obtained local media/measurements do not inherit every catalog restriction merely through a join.
control_plane_note: Explicitly paired AWS or private home-lab service access is distinct from media-fetch SSRF policy. Service connectivity does not authorize arbitrary private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata fetches.
